The Solo family owned and maintained an '''apartment''' on the world of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the home planet of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. They owned this place during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].
